data.name: Mai's Hunger
data.detailed_description:
A desperate husband, a demonic pact, and a burger joint that hides a gruesome secret.

Mai's Hunger is a tense first-person horror-simulation game where you must balance the mundane life of a fast-food manager with the sinister duties of a cultist.

Your wife, Mai, is locked in a secret room, slowly being consumed by a demonic entity. To save her from full possession, you have made a dark pact with "The Boss." By night, your burger joint opens its doors to hungry customers. By midnight, those same customers become the ingredients for your survival.

Key Features:

  • Two Lives, One Night: Manage your time carefully. Grill the burgers, serve the patrons, and keep the restaurant running smoothly to maintain your cover. Let the meat burn, and your night might end in a fiery disaster.

  • Hunt in the Shadows: Use stealth to drug or knock out isolated customers. Drag their bodies through a network of secret passages hidden behind the restrooms and storage areas without raising suspicion.

  • The Macabre "Yin-Yang" Shelf: Navigate the terrifying Freezer room and utilize a twisted rotating mechanism. Spin the shelf to swap between the fresh, whole corpses of your victims and the gruesome end product: perfectly round human meat patties ready for the grill. Process bodies in the grinder to feed the unaware customers, or deliver the whole corpses to the Sacrifice Room to appease the demon.

  • Dynamic Crime & Punishment: Every misstep generates Crime Points. Raise your Wanted Stars and face escalating law enforcement. At lower levels, cops will hunt you with batons; at max level, they will shoot on sight. Fight back, hide, or run.

  • Multiple Endings: Your choices matter. Will you gather enough sacrifices to save Mai? Will the restaurant burn to the ground? Or will you succumb to the darkness completely?

data.short_description: Manage a nighttime burger joint with a gruesome secret. Drug customers, use the macabre rotating shelf to swap corpses for fresh human meat patties, and serve the unaware. Evade the police, feed a dark demon, and save your cursed wife in this tense first-person horror simulation.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent scenes of violence, blood, and gore. Players take on the role of a character who drugs, kidnaps, and murders NPCs. The gameplay includes depictions of dead bodies and a gruesome mechanic where human corpses are processed in a meat grinder to make food. Additionally, there is combat violence involving melee weapons and firearms when fighting against police NPCs. The game features strong themes of psychological horror, murder, and demonic sacrifice. It does not contain any sexual violence, sexual content, or self-harm.
